supersedes: Earlier 96-task general-learning programme; preserve only work aligned with this objective.

requirements.requirement: Runtime-owned context and seven interacting planes
requirements.completion_proof: One integrated end-to-end task from authorized source state through sufficient compilation, decision and verifiable receipt.
requirements.implementation_note: Offline durable context, bounded working set, authorized compilation, managed execution, typed decision and durable audit integrated. Learned intelligence and real model/tool qualification remain incomplete.

requirements.completion_proof: Exactly 32-byte round-trip, incompatible-family rejection and no implicit text reconstruction or authority.
Typed decisions, calibrated scopes and missing/stale/revoked evidence cause safe abstention; batch parity and actual cost.
requirements.implementation_note: Typed batch API and scoped calibration mathematics tested; real provider calibration and matched controls remain.

requirements.completion_proof: Held-out correctness and risk/coverage at measured total cost against fixed retrieval and full context.
requirements.implementation_note: Explicit coverage plus optional learned judged-pool prefix planning and whole-trajectory risk accounting. Six RTX fits and 3677 regression queries completed; no calibration scope passed, so full-pool fallback remains. Answer sufficiency, automatic materialization, genuine token/latency benefit and prospective qualification remain.

requirements.completion_proof: Dimensioned cost/value objective, hard authority constraints and matched-cost ablations.
requirements.implementation_note: Remaining/next-batch judged-gain heads trained as auxiliary signals, without authorization powers. They are relevance fractions, not measured economic value. Token, latency, risk coefficients and task-outcome labels remain.

requirements.completion_proof: All ten stages integrated; exact small-instance control; larger-instance limits and model-specific tokenizer evidence.
requirements.implementation_note: Authorization, temporal validity, conflicts, closure, bounded exact/greedy selection, format/counter hooks and explicit coverage integrated. Learned value and faithful semantic compression remain.

requirements.completion_proof: Bounded capacities, pins, authorization and dependency correctness under eviction and faults.
requirements.implementation_note: Cold payloads, authenticated inventories, dependency-closed activation, pins, faults, eviction and cancellable explicit prefetch tested. Serialized resident-body quotas exclude catalogue/transient/caller memory; large-scale and model-token qualification remain.

requirements.completion_proof: Branched workflow only reruns affected work; changed model/tool/policy/input prevents inappropriate reuse.
requirements.implementation_note: Bounded pure DAG, affected active descendants, version/model/prompt/tool/verifier/policy-bound receipts and current authorization implemented. 23 tests and 720 fictional workflow requests pass. Localized changes reduce callbacks; policy-wide changes force recomputation. Durable scheduling, real model/tool integration and production qualification remain.

features: reasoning eviction separate from compliance retention
requirements.completion_proof: Retention holds, live dependents, archive integrity and permitted deletion tested.
requirements.implementation_note: HOT/WARM/COLD residency and reasoning eviction preserve immutable durable versions and pinned dependencies. Compliance retention holds, archival policy and physical deletion remain.

requirements.completion_proof: Bitemporal queries and late corrections without future leakage; current authorization for historical reads.
requirements.implementation_note: Durable signed history, validity/knowledge cutoffs, host transaction time, inverse supersession lineage and current authorization tested after restart. Distributed time semantics and large-scale qualification remain.

requirements.completion_proof: Model output/assumption cannot satisfy verified fact or policy requirements; canonical nodes and receipts preserve the type.
requirements.implementation_note: Ten explicit kinds and verified requirement restrictions; extraction and validation truth remain host-owned.

requirements.completion_proof: Conflicts remain inspectable, temporal/authority resolution auditable, ambiguous claims abstain.
requirements.implementation_note: Declared same-name claim conflicts retained and resolved by explicit host policy or abstention; semantic contradiction extraction/graph remains.

requirements.completion_proof: Known absence avoids redundant calls until expiry; denial does not leak hidden existence.
requirements.implementation_note: Typed negative knowledge, expiry and hidden-dependency filtering tested; tool acquisition/retry integration remains.

requirements.completion_proof: Prospective chronological task streams; total cost, wrong prefetch, revocation and zero-repeat controls.
requirements.implementation_note: Explicit asynchronous prefetch stays inactive until demand; cancellation, late completion, revocation and foreground priority tested. Fixed-successor prefetch was slower than working-set reuse alone in all three synthetic repeat regimes. Learned prediction and prospective public tasks remain; prefetch is opt-in.

requirements.completion_proof: New graph/time/policy model beats matched simpler controls on verified tasks; existing attention did not earn promotion.
Separate labels/head losses, disjoint calibration and held-out task/cost gains with all head ablations.
requirements.implementation_note: Three public-judgment heads with explicit labels/losses, linear/MLP controls and three seeds implemented. Failed calibration and transfer preserved. No reader correctness, missing-fact, conflict, staleness or decision heads qualified; prospective gains and head ablations remain.

requirements.completion_proof: Shared node contract and task metrics for each modality; prior media pilots do not establish this integration.
requirements.implementation_note: Canonical modality and external media digest contract only; media extraction/adapters and quality evaluations remain.

requirements.requirement: Reproducible RTX and interchangeable model stack
features: actual edge-device memory, latency, energy and offline operation
requirements.completion_proof: Pinned licensed candidates, complete task and resource accounting, no simultaneous-model fit assumption.
requirements.implementation_note: Two local environments, initial batch sweep and eight longer precision/capacity windows. BF16 is not a uniform speedup; new context/decision/VLM candidates and held-out qualification remain.

requirements.completion_proof: Licenses/revisions/native scoring, prospective task IDs, contamination/length audit and matched strong controls.
requirements.implementation_note: Expanded to model-alone versus runtime-assisted open-weight/frontier pairs, coding-agent harness comparisons and quality/cost/latency/resource accounting. Start locally; frontier preparation only, no paid calls authorized. Established harness and license review precede execution. LongBench v2 native-prompt/parser development controls completed: 30 calls on ten short tasks across six domains; full 4/10, BM25 4/10, no context 3/10. No runtime treatment or frontier ranking. Harbor 0.23.0 isolated command/task boundary and two native Terminal-Bench 2.1 graders qualified. Qwen2.5 1.5B corrected development baseline fails both tasks (0/2); initial failed attempt retained. Six calls, exact input-token parity, no benchmark training or runtime treatment. Sixteen terminal-boundary tests and data-only replay added. Stronger reference and real local adaptation remain.

requirements.requirement: Durable audit, reliability, ownership and honest release
requirements.completion_proof: Restart/race/revocation/security evidence, permitted exports, claim-to-evidence report and reproducible release.
requirements.implementation_note: Transactional audit, managed dispatch/cancellation/reconciliation and durable signed context integrated with crash/race/revocation tests. Parent callback cancellation, descendant containment, retention/deletion, export policy and independent replication remain. Local Beta-smoothed policy fitting and transactional promotion registry now have simulated adaptation, rejection and rollback evidence. No automatic SLM-weight update, automatic drift detection, signed promotion-audit integration or device-level benefit qualified.

evidence_boundary: Existing/draft sources do not prove the complete requirement. No 1.0 or universal capability claim.
primary_application_objective: Small domain models that operate and improve locally within explicit correctness, latency, memory, energy and cost limits.
capability_boundary: Domain AGI is an ambition, not an achieved or tested capability. Simulated local-policy adaptation is not qualified SLM weight improvement or edge deployment.
adaptation_contract: Verified memory updates; statistical context-policy proposals; fresh paired evaluation with persistent error-budget accounting; reversible activation. Model-weight adaptation and automatic drift detection remain unqualified.
